program.code:
def forward(groups):
    month, sp1, day, sp2, time = groups
    text = month + ' ' + day + ' ' + time
    dt = datetime.strptime(text, '%b %d %H:%M:%S')
    return {'stored': [int(dt.timestamp())], 'layout': [len(sp1), len(sp2), len(day)]}

def inverse(record):
    timestamp = int(record['stored'][0])
    layout = record.get('layout', [])
    sp1_len, sp2_len, day_width = layout
    dt = datetime.fromtimestamp(timestamp)
    month = dt.strftime('%b')
    day = str(dt.day).zfill(day_width)
    time = dt.strftime('%H:%M:%S')
    return month + (' ' * sp1_len) + day + (' ' * sp2_len) + time
